$$
B=[\begin{aligned}1 & r & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{aligned}].
$$

Given that the minor of ${b}_{23}$ is $15$, find the value of $r$ in the matrix above.

$r=$
 {{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
To evaluate the minor of ${b}_{23},$ we remove the second row and third column: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}1 & r & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${b}_{23}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}1 & r \\ 7 & 8\end{aligned}] & =1\cdot 8-r\cdot 7 \\  & =8-7r.\end{aligned}
$$

We're told that the minor of ${b}_{23}$ is $15$, so we get

$$
\begin{aligned}8-7r & =15 \\ -7r & =7 \\ r & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $r=-1.$
